content.value: Calculate the volume of landfill area needed to serve a population of 20,000 for a (07) period of 20 years. The solid waste generation rate is 2 kg/person/day. The density of uncompacted solid waste is $1 0 0 \ k g / \mathrm m ^ { 3 }$ and compaction ratio of 3.5 is suggested. The ratio of compacted fil $( \mathsf { S W } + \mathsf { c o v e r } )$ to compacted solid waste is 1.5.
